$comment: Single source of truth for combat keywords. Help menu + tooltips both read this. Colors intentionally omitted — assign PixelUI tokens per the meaning-first palette (green reserved for Protocol).

keywords.def: Damage over time. Deals the listed amount each turn for the listed number of turns.
keywords.syntax: X burn, Yt = X damage per turn for Y turns

keywords.def: The damage also hits a second target — the lowest-HP other enemy — at 60% (round down). Chain ×2 adds a second jump.
Consumes the target's Burn: deals burn amount × remaining turns as immediate damage, then the Burn is cleared.
If the target is below 25% max HP after the base damage, deal bonus damage.
Destroys all shield on the target before the damage lands, for everyone. Breach all strips every enemy.
The attacker heals HP equal to 50% of the damage dealt to HP (after shields).
The next hit on this target deals +50% (round up), then the Mark is consumed.
The unit's next damaging hit deals double damage, then the charge is consumed.
This round, any enemy that damages this unit takes N back. Never persists past the round.
Damage goes straight to HP. The shield is not removed and still blocks other attackers.
Absorbs incoming damage before HP. Lasts one round: gone at round end. Pierce goes through it; Breach destroys it.
keywords.syntax: N shield = N shield this round

keywords.def: Restores HP, up to the target's max.
Returns a downed ally to play at a percentage of max HP.
keywords.syntax: revive X% = revive at X% max HP

keywords.def: Lowers an enemy's effective roll, dropping its ability to a weaker band.
keywords.syntax: -N roll, [Yt] = -N to roll, optionally for Y turns

keywords.def: Raises an ally's effective roll, pushing its ability to a stronger band.
The target's next roll is capped at 12. Shown on the die, not as a status chip.
The target's next roll is set to 3. Telegraphed: applied this turn, it fires at the next roll.
Enemy-only: this enemy's next roll copies the value of the heroes' current highest die.
The die is locked and the unit skips its next N reveals. Identical for heroes and enemies; frozen dice stay in the tray as blockers.
keywords.note: Petrify is cosmetic Freeze (stone-gray instead of ice).

keywords.def: Untargetable by single-target abilities. Breaks when the unit deals damage or is hit by an AoE; the first attack made from Cloak gains Pierce.
Blocks the next ability that targets this unit, then breaks. An AoE that includes the unit is blocked for that unit only.
Enemy-only (Accretion): the lured hero can only target the lurer next turn.
Enemy-only (Accretion): this unit gains N shield at the start of each of its turns.
Forces the chosen enemy to target the taunter.
Enemy-only: on hit, drains N Protocol from your pool (never below 0).
Adds to the shared Protocol pool immediately (on top of the +1/turn income).
The effect hits every valid target (all enemies, or the whole squad) rather than one.
keywords.syntax: (all) on damage; "all" / "squad" on buffs and heals

conventions.duration: A trailing number + 't' is duration in turns (e.g. 2t = lasts 2 turns).
conventions.targeting: self / ally / squad / lowest / enemy / all denote who the effect lands on.
